journeys.name: Add a new training provider
journeys.description: Allows an administrator to add a new training provider to the register by searching UKPRN, entering details, and confirming submission.

journeys.name: Manage a provider
journeys.description: Enables an administrator to select a registered provider and perform management actions such as updating status, type, or allowed courses.

journeys.name: Restrict a provider to specific courses
journeys.description: Lets an administrator restrict a provider to deliver only approved courses.

journeys.name: Add a restricted course to a provider
journeys.description: Allows administrators to add a restricted apprenticeship course to a training provider and confirm the details.

journeys.name: Browse and manage restricted apprenticeship courses
journeys.description: Lets administrators review all restricted courses and access management options for them.

journeys.name: Restrict an unrestricted apprenticeship course
journeys.description: Enables an administrator to take an unrestricted course and apply restriction, making it restricted for providers.

journeys.name: Add a provider to a restricted course
journeys.description: Lets an administrator add a training provider to deliver a restricted course and confirm this action.

journeys.name: Manage a specific training provider
journeys.description: Allows the user to select a provider and manage their details, type, status, or allowed courses.

journeys.name: Add a restricted course for a provider
journeys.description: Enables administrators to add a new restricted apprenticeship course for a provider.

journeys.name: Change last start date for a restricted course of a provider
journeys.description: Allows administrators to change or set the last allowed start date for a restricted course a provider can deliver.

journeys.name: Remove a restricted course from a provider
journeys.description: Allows administrators to remove a course restriction from a provider.

journeys.name: Restrict a provider
journeys.description: Allows administrators to restrict a provider to only deliver approved courses.

journeys.name: Search and restrict an unrestricted course
journeys.description: Allows the user to search for an unrestricted course and restrict it.

journeys.name: Restrict an unrestricted course
journeys.description: Lets administrators restrict a course from unrestricted to restricted status.
